data.name: Zoo Animal Party (16-35 Attendees)
data.headline: 1 Hour • 16 - 35 Children or Adults • Celebrations •  Special Events
data.description:
Make your next celebration in San Diego, California extra special by inviting Zovargo to bring some of our amazing animals!

You should select a party size that is for the number of people (children or adults) interacting with animals.

Our animal parties are full of fun and excitement for all ages.
data.itinerary:
⏰  We will arrive 15-30 mins prior to the start time to get set up

🚐 Please save a close parking spot for us so we can easily and safely load in the animals, tables, props and decor! 

🎉 We'll take 15-30 mins to get set up. During this time, please do have guests occupied with another activity. 

🐾 Once we begin, you can expect an hour of interactive fun where guests are asked to participate in learning about and meeting the animals. 

😃 We do ask for helpers from the audience and that can be the birthday person or someone else who would like to volunteer! 

🎂 We lead the crowd in a "happy birthday shout out" or we acknowledge the special occasion and can lead the crowd in any way you prefer for other celebrations.

meeting_point.address: We bring the Zoo to You!

data.what_is_included:
Our mobile animal experience is like having your own private zoo experience - brought to you!

* 5 Zoo Animals
* 60 Minutes
* Thematic music enhances the experience
* Interactive opportunities for guests to be part of the program
* 2-10 professional animal handlers/educators
* Unique experience that is unmatched 
* Memories for a lifetime!
data.what_is_not_included: Please provide a location with full shade (canopy preferred) away from bodies of water, food, your personal pets/other animals, and where guests cannot walk behind our set up 🚧
data.what_to_bring: 📸 We provide photo opportunities with the special person interacting with the animals. If you might be occupied during the event, we recommend someone being ready with a camera to take pictures of the special moments.
data.cancellation_notes:
There are no refunds. We operate rain or shine.

Canceling 31+ days prior will receive a refund of 75% of the paid value. 
Canceling within 30 days of your scheduled event will result in no refund. 
The FareHarbor booking fee is not refundable.
Reschedule requests are required 30 days in advance. 
Donations are not refundable or tax deductible. 
We reserve the right to reschedule/refund if we need to cancel a program.
data.booking_notes:
###Thanks for booking with us! 

###You will receive an automated email reminder 7 days before the party. We will also check-in with you via text the day before to confirm all final details.

Please email or text us at 619-618-0745 if you have questions regarding your event. 

-----
Please remember the following:

⏰  We will arrive 15-30 mins prior to the start time to get set up

🚐 Please save a parking spot for us 

🐾 We will bring animals from either your top or alternate choices. While we aim for your top choices, your top choices may not always be available. Thank you for understanding. 

🎈🔈Please no balloons/streamers/loud music in the animal area

⛱  Please provide a location with full shade (canopy preferred) away from bodies of water, food, your personal pets/other animals, and where guests cannot walk behind our set up 🚧 

☔️ We operate rain or shine. In the event of rain, please provide fully covered or indoor location

🔥 In the event of high temps (>85°F) we appreciate an indoor, air conditioned location or access to power so we can bring our own fans for cooling (some zoo animals are sensitive to heat).

👀 We expect ALL children will be supervised by a parent or adult during the program

🍕 To keep guests and the animals safe, we ask that there is no eating/snacks during the animal program. 

🥾 Are there any stairs or other possible challenges for getting to the set up location? Let us know now by replying to this email 

Thank you!!

data.health_and_safety_notes:
##What to Expect:##
• For groups larger than 15 children, the animal interactions may be limited. This means that not every child will get to touch and hold every animal. The birthday child will get maximum animal interactions, along with special photo opportunities so the family can capture the moments! 

• **Animal Interactions:**  Please refer to our animal page to see how you can interact with our animals. Most of our animals allow for touching or holding unless stated otherwise. 

• For your safety and sanitation, eating is strictly discouraged during the animal program. 

• Guests will be encouraged to liberally use hand sanitizer that will be provided.
data.disclaimers: ☔️ We operate rain or shine. In the event of rain, please provide fully covered or indoor location.
